headline: Adani Power Net Profit Jumps 142% on Power Demand and Prior-Period Billing
summary: Adani Power reported a 142% surge in July-September net profit, supported by nearly 30% growth in operating revenue, robust electricity demand during weak monsoon rains, and historic tariff adjustments.
why: Adani Power is India's largest private thermal power producer, serving as an indicator of industrial activity and seasonal baseload electricity consumption.

impacts.name: Adani Power Ltd
impacts.why: Strong underlying generation demand and the recognition of historic energy charges bolster earnings and cash flows.
